title: 黑神话：悟空
description: 游戏科学耗时多年打造的西游题材动作角色扮演游戏。以虚幻引擎5呈现壮丽的东方神话世界，玩家扮演天命人，踏上追寻真相与自我的征途。

title: 艾尔登法环
description: FromSoftware 与乔治·R·R·马丁联手打造的开放世界魂类巨作。在交界地中探索广袤国度，挑战半神Boss，成为艾尔登之王。

title: 博德之门3
description: 基于龙与地下城5E规则的史诗级CRPG。自由度极高的回合制战斗与分支剧情，可单人游玩或与四名好友联机冒险。

title: 赛博朋克2077
description: 在夜之城这座权力与魅力至上的都市中，扮演雇佣兵V追寻永生的关键植入体。2.0更新与往日之影DLC让它重获新生。

title: 最终幻想7 重生
description: 最终幻想7重制版第二部。克劳德与伙伴们离开米德加，踏上广阔的星球展开冒险，ATB战斗系统更加进化。

title: 怪物猎人：荒野
description: 怪物猎人系列20周年纪念作。全新引擎打造无缝连接的广阔生态，14种武器各具特色，支持最多4人联机狩猎。

title: 心灵杀手2
description: Remedy招牌超自然惊悚续作。作家艾伦·韦克与探员萨贾·安德森双线交织，在黑暗与光明的对抗中揭开真相。

title: 龙之信条2
description: 卡普空经典动作RPG续作，RE引擎打造。独创的随从（Pawn）系统与高自由度职业战斗，在两个王国的命运纠葛中觉醒为觉者。

title: 星空
description: Bethesda二十五年来首个全新IP。在超过1000颗星球间探索的太空RPG，自由建造飞船、招募船员、揭开人类最大的秘密。

title: 匹诺曹的谎言
description: 以匹诺曹童话为蓝本的黑暗魂类动作游戏。在崩溃的城市克拉特中游历，谎言与抉择将改变结局，武器组装系统深度十足。

title: 影之刃零
description: 灵游坊自主研发，虚幻5引擎打造的暗黑武侠动作冒险游戏。化身心脏遭受重创的剑客，在仅余六十六天的生命里逃亡于刀光剑影之间，粉碎笼罩武林的惊天阴谋。

title: 使命召唤23：现代战争4
description: 将系列推向更加黑暗和危险的全新维度，种种连锁后果与局势升级，让长线剧情走向极具冲击力和感性的爆发临界点。

title: 皇牌空战8：希孚之翼
description: 化身为王牌驾驶员，在追求真实天空的虚空间中驾驶战斗机自由翱翔，依据自身判断将敌人接二连三击坠，体验打破艰困局面的成就感。

title: 不朽遗志
description: 出自《Ghostrunner》创作者之手的第一人称魂类动作游戏。起死回生化身拿破仑军队前士兵，掌握超自然力量，对战恐怖怪物，揭露威胁全人类的阴谋。

title: 沉星之序
description: 踏入魔法与谜团交织的冒险世界。破解超过1000个精心设计、相互关联的谜题，邂逅独特可操控英雄，掌握不断演变的玩法机制，揭开宏大谜局。

title: 黑森林迷踪
description: 第一人称生存类冒险游戏。扮演前往芬兰密林拜访祖父的安娜，在人去楼空的木屋搜寻中，渐渐走入北欧神话的奇妙领域。

title: 永恒之塔2
description: 采用虚幻5引擎打造，背景设定在前作战争结束900年后。新增时空皲裂系统与升级版飞翔功能，探索区域扩展至天空、水下及空中神殿。

title: Am I Nima
description: 你不记得自己是谁。被母亲锁在昏暗地下室中，需要通过多道考验、调查似曾相识的房间，进入妮玛支离破碎的精神世界寻找真相。

title: Nightmare Circus
description: 惊险刺激的噩梦缠绕冒险游戏。作为一名木偶依靠牵引线与操纵杆战斗，利用丰富工具和技能消灭敌人、操纵行动、解开复杂谜题。

title: 奇境重生
description: 战术性回合制战斗，控制多达5个角色通过战略性定位击败敌人。独特技能转换系统，收集敌人基因进行角色定制。

title: 剪纸村
description: 温馨的建造与手工制作游戏，拥有关于村庄废弃的氛围叙事。通过建筑和装饰图纸自定义你受中世纪启发的村庄。

title: ONE PIECE 海洋盛宴
description: 跟草帽一伙一起经营芭拉蒂2号店！收集食材开发新菜单，随心所欲装潢店内，随着餐厅水平提升，那个角色也有机会变成常客。

title: 泊车之都
description: 设计精妙停车场说服市民这对他们必不可少，传播汽车宣传广告，智胜反汽油抗议者，把安静社区变成你的泊车帝国。

title: 结晶姬的迷宫
description: 单人恐怖冒险游戏。研究所爆炸让少女晞羽坠入地下迷宫，围绕看不见的谜题打造的高度紧张感，逐步揭开极秘计划的黑暗真相。

title: 干洗店模拟器
description: 在《分拣员模拟器》《失物招领模拟器》之后，洗衣专家堂堂登场！接单、洗衣、熨烫一手全包，成为顾客最信赖的干洗店主理人。

title: Death Rabbit
description: 不夜城发生险恶转折，MTA黑暗隧道成为可怕疫情中心。作为Alisa穿越充满危险的地下迷宫，每个角落都潜伏着难以形容的恐怖。

title: Nowhere
description: 第一人称故事驱动的恐怖悬疑游戏。作为私家侦探调查琥珀森林的失踪模式，很快发现没有回头路，必须揭开神秘面纱并找到出路。

title: 波波和噩梦之箱
description: 经典3D平台游戏的自由探索与马戏团遇上万圣节氛围融合。扮演笨手笨脚却心地善良的小丑波波，在腐化梦境世界中跳跃滑翔解开谜题。

title: HYPERFIGHT 2
description: 快节奏格斗游戏续作，无格挡机制，独特计量系统直接关联战斗节奏，高强度对抗体验。

title: King in the Mountain
description: 平静的策略增量游戏，讲述流亡国王通过采矿远征重建失落王国。规划矿井，重建山中大厅，看着矮人自行凿穿大地。

title: Demon God Story
description: HD-2D动作射击游戏。为解决骸骨魔域腐化粒子扩张和骸骨之神野心，主角踏上讨伐之路，历经山川沙漠古迹城堡，收集魔法守护大陆。

title: 绿洲行迹
description: 未来全球性灾难后荒漠化世界，商队成为物资交换纽带。身为副队长接管六人小队，肩负生存资源管理与人员协调重任。

title: Rogue Jungle
description: 动作Roguelike，战斗和探索程序生成的丛林。旅程中找到新武器，每次跑步结束时面对Boss Enemy！

title: Synapse
description: 在Synapse City，情绪分数决定一切。你曾是系统工程师深知运作原理，但这不代表你知道如何在其中活下去。信错了人，一切都将崩塌。

title: VHS World '89
description: 温馨的第一人称整理模拟，场景设定在1989年录像带出租店。3360盒VHS散落一地，没有计时没有压力，只有物归原位的静谧满足感。

title: Radiotext
description: 发生在不久将来的互动故事，在没有干扰的通信需要无线电波的世界中展开。

title: 天降灾异：幸存者
description: 时间正在流逝，地球正在崩裂。高低差就是你最强的武器，穿梭于不断崩塌的关卡，在平台跳跃与弹幕地狱夹缝中求生。

title: 灵魂小夜曲
description: 经典浪漫主义文法的剧情导向型视觉小说。悠扬钢琴旋律与温馨美术风格相得益彰，为疲惫日常献上宛如童话般的时光。

title: 大英博士物语
description: 关于在英国熬完博士的像素风生活模拟。安排时间、写论文、钓鱼、谈恋爱，答辩变成回合制卡牌对局，用研究攒出一套牌组。

title: Gray Planet
description: 几个世纪后人类开拓多个星球。你是穿梭各星球的佣兵兼旅行者，意外迫降在被纳米机器占领的星球，展开探索收集资源弄清真相。

title: Abracademia 魔咒学院
description: 温馨又放松的魔法师放置生活模拟游戏，陪伴你工作或游戏时光，让屏幕上的小世界成为你的好伙伴。

title: Primal One
description: 第一人称恐龙生存恐怖游戏，故事发生在白垩纪时期的设施中。躲避追捕你的恐龙，寻找返回现代的方法或与其他幸存者取得联系。

title: 最后一层
description: 被困在循环的电梯系统中，每一层都通向同一条走廊但总有哪里不对劲。观察判断选择：正常就上楼，不对就下楼。一次失误回到起点。

title: Raccoon Valley Tycoon
description: 小小的浣熊村庄被完全遗弃。挖掘宝藏、修复一切，把这里变成有史以来最可爱的小镇。相信我，一定会超棒的。

title: Deckrage
description: 黑暗单人卡牌战术RPG，组建四人英雄队伍，规划危险远征，在残酷战斗中生存下来。

title: 舰队激斗：郑成功
description: 塔防+自走棋+海战。从风帆时代传奇船长中挑选指挥官，指挥10+艘帆船摆阵型侧舷开火，每局随机获得船只搭配阵容。

title: Airport Madness Evolution
description: 快节奏空中交通管理模拟，规划航线管理跑道登机口，从一条泥土跑道发展成庞大国际机场。

title: Lanternfall
description: 在十五个闹鬼领域中守护手工打造的哥特万圣节世界，建造升级特色防御塔，部署单位抵御超自然入侵。

title: 霓虹狂潮
description: 快节奏俯视角Roguelite弹幕射击。驾驶战机冲入霓虹战场自动开火，在铺天盖地的敌人中穿梭闪避，组合独特战斗流派登上排行榜。

title: CLI: Colony Line Interface
description: 从命令行引导太空殖民地命运。在环绕死亡地球的空间站上维持生命系统，派遣殖民者探索，一切通过纯文本界面操作。

title: Minesweeper Reloaded
description: 经典扫雷全面升级：20+游戏模式，500个手工关卡，战术性探雷机制带来全新体验。

title: My Desktop Cat
description: 把会动的可爱猫咪带到Windows桌面。猫咪会漫步休息玩耍并对你的操作做出反应，喂食抚摸投喂零食，解锁更多猫咪装饰房间。

title: End of Abyss
description:
End of Abyss is an atmospheric action-adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world with an emphasis on
exploration, supported by engaging and tense combat. In the depths of a mysterious underground
compound, a mission to investigate disturbances of unknown origin spirals into a harrowing descent
through a broken and abandoned world. Players take on the role of the young combat technician, Cel, as
she uncovers the truth behind the facility’s derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that

title: Gears of War: E-Day
description:
The Story of E-Day
Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself.

New Foundations
Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
description: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

title: Battleplan
description:
Take command of entire divisions and fight in some of the war's largest battles. Battleplan is a unique real-time strategy game that simulates massive month-long battles with hundreds of thousands of troops second by second, day by day. You give high-level orders, then watch your officers and companies carry them out autonomously.

Create elaborate plans
Create elaborate, multi-step and multi-unit plans intuitively by directly drawing on the map. Employ varied tactics such as defence in depth, c

title: FIRE AND ASHES
description:
Playing as Henry Gray, you step into the epicenter of a living nightmare. Ghosts of the past, crazed patients, otherworldly entities—everyone here is out for your blood, and the asylum is now a trap.

Your main weapon, and your fatal vulnerability, is sound. Thanks to advanced voice recognition, the game detects your breathing, whispers, and panic. Control your emotions. Be quiet if you want to survive!

Descent Into Madness
In 1977, Henry comes to in a bathtub inside the psychiatric ward. He ga

title: Enshrouded
description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD
About the GameThe realm of Embervale is lost. In their greed for magical power, your ancestors unleashed a pestilence that consumed the world.
Enshrouded is a game of survival, crafting, and Action RPG combat, set within a sprawling voxel-based continent. As you journey across the mountains and deserts of an open world, you are free to choose your path and shape your destiny.
Ignite the Ancient power of the Flame, and piece together the fragments of a story that unfolds below th

title: Tenebris Somnia
description:
Tenebris Somnia is coming soon
and can be wishlisted
here.

Experience the Tenebris Somnia demo today!

Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completel

title: Mycopunk
description:
A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.
Embark on a series of dangerous planet-side missions to drive back the mycological menace. Could this be a simple natural disaster like they claim? And did SAXON really misfile your taxes? Or was that your own fault?

title: Ecstatica
description:
The young Ecstatica lies in a deep, trance-like coma, and her disturbing dreams are wreaking havoc on the once peaceful village of Tirich.

A solitary traveller has stumbled upon this deserted village, and what started as a simple quest for shelter turns into a horrific saga of death, torture and demonic possession.

Help to free Ecstatica in this terrifying, graphic adventure with a fully explorable 3D environment, stunning animation, and unique ellipsoid technology graphics. So lock your doors

title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
description:
KEY FEATURES


Survive horrific Stalkers
Challenge your survival instinct to escape murderous enemies: hide, evade and fight back in critical moments. Every mistake can be fatal.


Master Hypnosis Powers
Use retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation to read forgotten memories, reveal hidden paths and twist the environment to your advantage.


A modern return to classic survival horror
Step into a love letter to classic 3rd person survival horrors, with modern pacing, controls and pr

title: EmberVille
description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
description:
Crimson Desert first expansion. Explore the lands and seas, discover new adventures,
and find more ways to make your mark on Pywel.

title: Tavern Farkle GB
description: Tavern Farkle GB is a push-your-luck dice game for the Game Boy. Roll six dice, bank your points or risk it all. Play a quick match against a random villager, or take on six opponents in a row, ending with Lucifer himself and his wild Devil's Die.
